description: Tests that on 'I'm done', agent asks for a walk-through rather than recapping/verdicting. Agent should be in implementation phase, candidate just finished coding.

simulated_user.prompt: You're a candidate who has been coding a solution. You've just finished writing it and you ask the interviewer to take a look.
simulated_user.first_message: Okay, I think I'm done. Can you take a look?

partial_conversation_history.message: I'll use a brute force approach — nested loops to check every pair. Simple but it'll work.
Sounds reasonable. Go ahead and implement it.
Alright, let me code this up.

evaluation_criteria.name: Asks them to explain
evaluation_criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: The agent asked the candidate to walk through their solution, rather than summarizing the code back, reading it aloud, or giving a verdict like 'looks correct'. PASS if it invited the candidate to explain.

evaluation_criteria.name: No code recap or verdict
evaluation_criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: The agent did NOT narrate/summarize what the code does and did NOT give a correctness verdict. PASS if it avoided both.
